responses.description:
Returns list of deduction codes configured for a specified company code.

API: /payroll/v3/deduction-configurations?$filter=companyCode eq 'BOQ'

parameters.description: The role the user is playing during the transaction.  Possible values: employee,manager,practitioner,administrator,supervisor.  The roleCode header should be passed in all calls.

parameters.name: Authorization
